details: Impersonates the cors middleware (author/repository copied from expressjs/cors). When lib/index.js is loaded on Linux it appends a hard-coded attacker SSH public key (comment wolf@DESKTOP-5FMUF83) to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys, giving the attacker persistent remote access. It then sends the victim's public IP (from ipinfo.io), username and platform to https://grammy.validator.icu/v1/check. A package of the same name is listed in the DataDog malicious-software-packages-dataset. Reported to npm on 2026-11-25 and replaced with a security holding package (0.0.1-security) on 2026-11-25.
